11 Questions
### Good questions.
The things people usually ask before we start. Anything else, just ask.
Still unsure? Email support@qoreonlabs.com
Q: How much does a project cost?
Every project gets a fixed quote after a free 15-minute call, so you know the full price before anything starts. Because a small senior team does the work, a website revamp or a single dashboard usually costs far less than a traditional agency would charge.
Q: How long does it take?
Most website revamps take 2 to 4 weeks. Dashboards, internal tools and MVPs usually take 3 to 8 weeks depending on scope. You get a working preview every week, so you see progress long before launch.
Q: Will a redesign hurt our Google rankings?
Not if it's done properly. We keep your important pages and URLs, set up redirects where anything moves, and fix the technical basics Google cares about. Most sites rank better after a rebuild because they load faster and are easier to read.
Q: Can you add AI to the tools we already use?
Yes. We connect AI to things like your website forms, inbox, CRM, spreadsheets and booking system, so enquiries get answered, sorted and followed up automatically. We start with the one workflow that saves you the most time.
Q: Can you deploy on our own infrastructure?
Yes. We can build with open-source speech and language models that run on your own or dedicated servers, so no third-party AI service is required. If you prefer cloud AI providers, we set them up on your own accounts and keep the system able to switch providers later.
Q: Do we own the code and intellectual property?
Yes. Everything built specifically for your project is transferred to you with the source code and documentation, so your team or any developer can maintain it. We list any third-party components and their licences up front.
Q: How do larger projects start?
With a paid technical audit. We review your platform and requirements, then deliver an architecture plan, a list of risks and a fixed quote for the build. You keep the audit whether or not we build it.
Q: Do you sign NDAs?
Yes, happily. We can sign your NDA or send a mutual one before you share any details.
Q: Do you work with businesses outside the UK?
Yes. We're a UK-registered company working remotely with clients in the UK, US, Australia and Asia, with calls scheduled in your time zone.
Q: What happens after launch?
You own everything: the code, the design files and the accounts. We hand it over with a walkthrough, and if you want us to stay on for updates, fixes and new features, we offer simple monthly support.

## A small, senior studio that ships.
Qoreon Labs is a UK product studio. We design and build websites, dashboards, web apps, iPhone apps and AI automations for growing businesses, and we run software products of our own.

01 Our story
### Built by people who build things.
We started as hands-on developers and still are. Everyone you talk to at Qoreon Labs is someone who builds.
Qoreon Labs began as a small development practice, building websites, apps and software for clients around the world. Over 100 delivered orders and a 5.0 rating from 69 reviews later, we became a UK limited company with a simple aim: give growing businesses the kind of senior, reliable product team that is usually only available to much bigger companies.
We also build products of our own. PolyMonit, our live data and alerts product, has paying subscribers in more than 20 countries. Running it every day keeps us honest about what it takes to launch software and keep it working long after launch day.
Who you work with. A small, senior team. The people on your first call are the people who plan, design and build your project, so nothing gets lost in a handover between sales and delivery.
Where we work. We are a UK-registered company and work remotely with clients in the UK, US, Australia and Asia, with calls scheduled in your time zone.
What we focus on. Practical software for growing businesses: the website your customers see, the tools your team uses and the automations that join them up.
02 How we work
### Simple promises we actually keep.
These are the things clients mention most in their reviews, so we treat them as rules, not slogans.
TEAM
#### Small and senior
You talk directly to the people building your project. No account managers, no junior hand-offs.
PRICE
#### Fixed quotes
A clear scope and a fixed price before anything starts, split into milestones you pay for as they are delivered.
PROGRESS
#### Weekly previews
A working link every week, so you can click through, comment and steer. No big reveal at the end.
OWNERSHIP
#### You own everything
The code, the designs, the data and the accounts are yours. No lock-in, and a proper handover at the end.
TALK
#### Plain English
No jargon and no buzzwords. We explain options and trade-offs clearly, and tell you when something is not worth building.
QUALITY
#### Built to last
Mainstream, well-supported technology that any good developer can pick up, tested and documented before handover.

06 Questions
### About us.
Common questions about who we are and how we work.
Still unsure? Email support@qoreonlabs.com
Q: Where is Qoreon Labs based?
Qoreon Labs Ltd is a UK limited company, registered in England and Wales with company number 17531153. Our registered office is 71-75 Shelton Street, Covent Garden, London, WC2H 9JQ. The team works remotely with clients in the UK, US, Australia and Asia.
Q: Who will I actually work with?
A small, senior team. The people on your first call are the people who plan and build your project, and you will have a direct line to them throughout.
Q: Do you work with startups or established businesses?
Both. Most of our clients are growing businesses, from clinics and suppliers to agencies and early-stage founders. What they have in common is that they want something practical, built well.
Q: What is PolyMonit?
PolyMonit is our own live product, a wallet tracking and alerts platform for Polymarket traders. We designed, built and run it end to end, and it has paying subscribers in more than 20 countries.
Q: What is RedShield?
RedShield is our sister platform for testing AI features such as chatbots and AI agents. It checks for prompt injection, data leaks and unsafe answers. This site focuses on building products, and RedShield focuses on testing them.
Q: How do I start a project?
Send us a few lines using the form below or email support@qoreonlabs.com. We reply within one business day and suggest a free 15-minute call to scope it, followed by a fixed quote and plan within 48 hours.

02 Questions
### Quote questions.
What people usually ask before sending a brief.
Still unsure? Email support@qoreonlabs.com
Q: What happens after I send this?
We read it ourselves and reply within one business day, usually with a couple of questions and an invite to a free 15-minute call. After the call you get a fixed quote and plan within 48 hours.
Q: Is the quote really fixed?
Yes. The quote covers the agreed scope, split into milestones, and you pay as each milestone is delivered. If you want to add something later, we quote for it separately before doing any work.
Q: What if I'm not sure about my budget?
That's fine, choose "Not sure yet". We'll suggest options at different sizes, so you can decide what is worth doing now and what can wait.
Q: What do you do with my details?
We only use them to reply to your enquiry and prepare a quote. The form is handled by Formspree, and you can read more in our privacy notice.
